choices.content: They are perpendicular to each other.
They are parallel (or lie on the same line) and equal in length.
They are parallel but unequal in length.

question.prompt: What relationship holds between the segments joining corresponding points after a translation?

solutions.explanation: In a translation, every point moves the same distance in the same direction, so the segments joining corresponding points are parallel (or lie on the same line) and equal in length.
solutions.title: Use the translation definition
